rules: No source polygon is promoted directly to canonical political geometry without reconciliation.
1300 evidence is not silently reused as 1326 ownership.
A source can establish an entity or event without establishing an exact boundary.
Political control is stored separately from political geography.
Uncertain boundaries retain confidence and provenance instead of being fabricated.
